entities.name: UniProt Q05071
observations: Exact full-length sequence match (237 aa) to reviewed Streptomyces virginiae protein Q05071, annotated as an uncharacterized N-acetyltransferase in the mutA 5′ region.

UniProt-linked GO annotation: acyltransferase activity transferring groups other than amino-acyl groups (GO:0016747); this broad annotation does not establish a specific substrate or cellular pathway.
Pfam scan returned no domain results; the analysis notes this may reflect module availability and is not evidence that the protein lacks domains.
